js.¿Es igual a la de hace 2 figuras?: Is it the same as the one from 2 shapes ago?

js.Resuelves rápido y casi sin errores. Man: You solve quickly and with almost no mistakes. Keep your level by raising the difficulty and practicing under pressure.
js.Prefieres asegurar la respuesta. Tu punt: You prefer to make sure of your answer. Your area to improve is pace: practice with a time limit to gain speed without losing accuracy.
You answer fast, but make mistakes. Pause for a moment to check before answering: in an interview, being right matters more than being first.
js.Todavía hay mucho por ganar: entrena uno: There is still a lot to gain: train a few minutes a day and you'll see quick improvements.
js.Respondiste muy pocas preguntas para sac: You answered too few questions to draw reliable conclusions. Repeat the challenge calmly and check your profile again.
js.Rutina sugerida: 10 minutos al día, 3 ve: Suggested routine: 10 minutes a day, 3 times a week. Repeat the challenge in 7 days and compare your index.
js.Vas muy bien. Sube la dificultad o reduc: You're doing great. Raise the difficulty or reduce the time to keep improving.
js.Cometes errores por apuro: revisa el ord: You make mistakes by rushing: check the order of magnitude before answering and practice decomposition (47 + 38 = 47 + 40 − 2).
js.Gana ritmo con las tablas del 6 al 9 y c: Build pace with the 6 to 9 times tables and with rounding (49 × 6 = 50 × 6 − 6).
js.Haz una pausa mental de medio segundo pa: Take a half-second mental pause to identify the rule before tapping, and read it quietly to yourself.
js.Practica ignorando el significado de la: Practice ignoring the meaning of the word: fix your eyes on the color and answer by reflex.
js.Te cuesta cambiar de regla: cuando cambi: Switching rules is hard for you: when it changes, repeat the new rule in your head and answer the first two calmly.
js.Antes de responder comprueba la regla co: Before answering, check the rule against all the terms, not just the first two.
js.Calcula siempre las diferencias entre té: Always compute the differences between terms; if you see no pattern, try ratios (×2, ×3) and squares.
js.Agrupa los bloques en pares o tríos y re: Group the blocks in pairs or triplets and remember the route as a path or a shape.
js.Repite en voz baja la última figura (y e: Quietly repeat the last shape (and in 2-back, the last two) to keep them active in your mind.
js.Decide con tu primer impulso: si dudas,: Go with your first instinct: if you hesitate, time runs out. Train your pace with short rounds.
js.mantener la concentración y adaptarte a: staying focused and adapting to rule changes
js.seguir varias cosas a la vez y actualiza: juggling several things at once and updating information
js.Antes de tocar, espera a reconocer la fi: Before tapping, wait until you recognize the shape: green circle is YES, red square is NO.
js.Compara primero el número de bloques y l: First compare the number of blocks and the corners to rule out options quickly.
js.Confía en tu primer reconocimiento y toc: Trust your first recognition and tap without hesitating when you see the green circle.
js.Copia el texto, descarga la imagen con t: Copy the text, download the image with your chart or share it.

js.Encuentra la figura que es la misma gira: Find the shape that is the same one, rotated. Careful: its mirror image is a different shape.
js.Gira la figura mentalmente por partes: f: Rotate the shape in your mind piece by piece: fix a reference corner and remember that a mirror image is not the same as a rotation.
js.Haz un barrido visual ordenado y localiz: Scan the screen in an orderly way and locate the next item before moving your finger.
js.Memoriza el ritmo: el disco pequeño se m: Memorize the rhythm: the small disc moves every other move and the other move is almost always the only legal one.
js.Mira la siguiente ficha mientras tocas l: Look at the next item while tapping the current one, and check whether a number or a letter comes next.
js.Mueve toda la torre al poste ★: Move the whole tower to the ★ peg
js.Ordena las fichas del 1 al 8: Put the tiles in order from 1 to 8

js.Ordena primero la fila de arriba y luego: Solve the top row first and then the left column, without undoing what you've already placed.
js.Pasa toda la torre al poste ★ con el men: Move the whole tower to the ★ peg using as few moves as possible. Never put a large disc on a small one.
js.Piensa por etapas: para mover N discos,: Think in stages: to move N discs, first take N−1 to the spare peg. The smallest disc always moves in the same direction.
js.Planifica tres movimientos antes de toca: Plan three moves before tapping and avoid going in circles.
js.Toca cuando veas el círculo verde. Si ap: Tap when you see the green circle. If the red square appears, don't tap.
js.Toca en orden alterno: 1, A, 2, B, 3, C…: Tap in alternating order: 1, A, 2, B, 3, C… as fast as you can, without mistakes.
